name: playwright-e2e
description: Author and maintain resilient Playwright end-to-end tests using the Page Object Model, fixtures, stable user-facing locators, and web-first assertions. Enforces guardrails against flakiness, brittle selectors, and shared state. Drives Playwright's built-in planner, generator, and healer agents (playwright-test MCP) and refactors their output to project conventions; also includes the live-browser Playwright MCP server.
